verdict.rationale: Runpod documents a REST API meant for 'automation systems', API-key authentication, an open-source CLI (runpodctl) with scriptable commands such as `runpodctl pod create`, and Python/JavaScript/Go SDKs. Together these let it be driven headlessly with no console. A runtime probe confirmed the REST API is live, publishes an OpenAPI spec, and is gated by an API key. missing for 10: no explicit CI-pipeline integration guide (e.g. GitHub Actions or non-interactive CI auth examples), no independent hands-on corroboration of CI usage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can run the product headlessly / in CI for automation
